contributions.detail: The filer substituted his own typed ledger for the county's Schedule A (§E5's portrait own-ledger case; the county's blank Schedule A form is bound at p2 carrying only the handwritten pointer 'See Attached Schedule A'). Four rows: 500.00 + 250.00 + 3000.00 + 250.00 = 4,000.00 exactly = the ledger's printed total. THE SCOPE IS PERIOD, and the document says so in words — the total line names the window '6/17/2018 through Oct 30 2018', which matches the ticked report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election' and starts where the filer's prior report ended; so this is the per-period figure the utah regime promotes, not a cycle cumulative. Nothing was differenced across filings to reach it.

expenditures.anchor: the attached ledger's OWN printed total — 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES THROUGH 6/17 thru Oct 30 2018   $ 44,944.26' (PDF p4). Again: no summary page, no Column A, no cover cross-check — the schedule's own printed figure is the only anchor this document offers.
expenditures.detail: 32 typed rows on the filer's own Schedule B ledger sum to 44,944.26 exactly: 500.00+715.05+34.95+500.00+500.00+687.48+62.52+10.00+515.50+5.16+500.00+618.60+6.19+500.00+500.00+500.00+200.00+500.00+34.37+25.00+501.58+25.00+10.00+81.22+10.00+10.00+10.00+3000.00+4000.00+1085.74+28245.90+1050.00 = 44,944.26 = the printed total to the cent. The §D5 spreadsheet SUM-RANGE-SLIP screen therefore returns clean: neither the first nor the last row is omitted from the printed total. Same period scope as the contributions side ('6/17 thru Oct 30 2018'). The last four rows are dated OUT OF ORDER (8/3, 8/6, 6/22, 6/27 after a 10/26 row) — appended by the filer; transcribed in printed order and included, as the printed total requires them.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'David Leavitt' (handwritten), party 'Republican', residence Orem, Office Seeking written as 'Utah County Attorney'; index.csv names no candidate and carries office 'County Attorney' — the page face agrees and supplies the name. Report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment answered 'No'; the SIGNATURE DATE BOX IS BLANK (signed but undated by the filer — an honest blank, not filled from the clerk's stamp), while the clerk's 'For Office Use Only' block carries TWO received marks, a blue machine stamp 'OCT 30 PM 3:51' and a red handwritten 'Oct 30, 4:51'. THIS FILING HAS NO SUMMARY PAGE AT ALL — the four pages are cover / the county's blank Schedule A form / the filer's own Schedule A ledger / the filer's own Schedule B ledger. Consequently there is NO Column A and NO cover figure to gate against, which is why the module's published stated totals are blank for this filing; each side was gated on its own ledger's printed total and nothing was synthesized (§E5/§F6). FORM STOCK: the cover is the common blank titled 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES' (Code 2-5 & 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13), while the one county inner sheet bound with it is strap-lined '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' — LEFTOVER 2016 STOCK inside a genuinely 2018 filing, exactly the `utah-template-vintage-year` case; the year is NOT reclassified and this is not a bound-in prior report. THE p2 BANNER: that blank county Schedule A carries one handwritten line on printed row 1 — 'See Attached Schedule A' — with every other cell, the subtotal and the total left empty, and its Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes blank. It is a §E3 BANNER LINE: an annotation that publishes NO row. The side is nonetheless `transcribed`, not `empty-schedule` and not `no-schedule-page`, because what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries (§A2/§E5) — they are on the attached ledger at p3. There is no county Schedule B form page anywhere in the document; only the filer's ledger. The filer's ledgers reproduce the county's own column headings, including 'Provider/Vendor' over the payee column on Schedule B (the fourth vocabulary, §H5) and no Purpose column on either. ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: on both ledgers the first typed line is row 1 (crop-proved), there is no voided or continuation line, the §B5 one-past control rendered an empty band on both pages so nothing continues below the last row (§F1), and no band was ~2x pitch, so no doubled band (§H3); both sides closed to the cent with no shortfall to diagnose. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT against the ledgers' own printed headings; dates, names, addresses and money each sit in their own column, with the one benign inversion noted per row (the 'Bank fee (UCCU)' cells, which name the purpose before the institution). PRIVACY: THE COUNTY'S REDACTION ON THIS FILING IS GREEN, NOT BLACK — three of the four donor address cells on p3 are covered by a solid green fill, while the fourth (Steve Lund) was left in the clear and the whole expenditure ledger on p4 is unredacted. Those three rows' city/state are blank BECAUSE THE COUNTY REDACTED THEM, which is a different fact from a filer leaving the cell empty; the one visible donor address was reduced to city/state at read time and no street line is carried anywhere in this record, including for vendors.
